finalText:
Build's clean now, exit code 0.

Two real bugs were hiding under the deprecation noise. `resolveRetries` in `src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. `isBackoffEnabled` in `src/net/retryPolicy.js` threw on `undefined` instead of treating it as `false`, which the new config loader now returns for unset flags.

Fixed both. The rest of the warnings are just deprecation noise from the bump, not errors.
